metaTitle: HVAC Advertising and PPC: Google Ads, LSA and Meta
metaDescription: HVAC advertising and PPC from ASP: Google Search Ads split by repair and replacement, Local Services Ads, Meta retargeting and budgets that follow the season.

hero.h1: HVAC PPC and Advertising Judged by Booked Jobs
hero.subhead: Get in front of homeowners when the AC quits or the furnace won't start. ASP runs your Google Ads, Local Services Ads and Meta, with budgets that follow the season.
points: Accounts and billing in your name
Every channel judged on cost per booked job

why.heading: Paid search that follows the weather
why.intro: HVAC call volume rises and falls with heating and cooling seasons. Your ad spend should move with it instead of running flat all year.

cards.title: Heat waves and cold snaps
cards.body: Emergency repair terms and Local Services Ads take the bigger share of budget when the weather turns hard.

cards.title: Spring and fall tune-ups
cards.body: Between the peaks, the account leans toward maintenance campaigns timed to the pre-season check-ups ENERGY STAR recommends.

cards.title: Spend tied to job value
cards.body: The right budget starts from what a booked job is worth to you. Ad spend goes straight to Google or Meta, separate from what you pay ASP.

services.heading: What we run in your HVAC ad accounts
services.intro: Three paid channels carry most home service ad spend. We run all three for HVAC and judge each on cost per booked job.

cards.title: Google Search Ads
cards.body: Repair, replacement and maintenance get their own ad groups, so you can see which clicks pay for themselves. Branded search sits in its own campaign.

cards.title: Local Services Ads
cards.body: HVAC is a US Local Services Ads category. You pay per lead, and Google screens every business before ads run.

cards.title: Meta retargeting
cards.body: Keep your name in front of homeowners who read your replacement or heat pump page and didn't call.

cards.title: Meta for hiring
cards.body: The techs you want are usually employed, not browsing job boards. Recruiting runs on its own budget, apart from lead generation.

cards.title: Call and booked-job tracking
cards.body: Calls are tracked by source and forms carry campaign tags. On Housecall Pro, booked revenue can go back to Google Ads as an offline conversion.

process.heading: How we run HVAC ad accounts

steps.title: Audit the account
steps.body: Settings, search terms, geography and conversion tracking get reviewed first. You see the findings and priorities before spend changes.

steps.title: Set clean defaults
steps.body: Phrase match, Presence location targeting, search partners off, display off on search campaigns, and a negative keyword list that grows weekly.

steps.title: Prove, then test
steps.body: Search and Local Services Ads are proven first. Performance Max is tested later, with clean conversion data and branded search excluded.

steps.title: Review every month
steps.body: Each month we go through spend by channel, booked jobs and what we change next.

pricing.heading: Packages that include HVAC ad management
pricing.subhead: Paid media management for Google Ads, Meta and LSA is included from Growth up. Ad spend is separate and goes straight to the platforms.

faqs.question: Are Local Services Ads worth it for an HVAC company?
faqs.answer: If you qualify and your reviews support it, LSA is usually the first paid channel we'd set up, because you pay per lead and the placement sits above the map. Search Ads still matter, since LSA inventory is capped in each metro.

faqs.question: Why do missed calls matter for LSA?
faqs.answer: Response time is part of how Google ranks Local Services Ads, and Google says missed calls may hurt your responsiveness. In peak season someone has to own the phone while techs are out, and message and booking leads can help on nights and weekends.

faqs.question: What badge do HVAC Local Services Ads carry now?
faqs.answer: Google now issues one badge, called Google Verified, and is discontinuing the Money Back Guarantee tied to the old badge. Your ads and website shouldn't promise one.

faqs.question: Will you change my conversion action to get out of learning faster?
faqs.answer: No. The conversion action stays set to the lead you sell, even if the account learns more slowly. We work with geography, budget weighting, ad count and creative instead.

faqs.question: Who owns the HVAC ad accounts?
faqs.answer: You do. Google Ads, Meta and Local Services Ads accounts are set up in your name and paid from your own billing, and there are no exit fees.

cta.heading: Get your HVAC ad account audited
cta.body: Share access to your Google Ads and Local Services Ads accounts, and you'll see the findings and the priority order before any budget changes.
